descriptions.w3d_d24g_input_move_jump_actions_80058a6: Appends input actions to the owner's pointer vector at +36: Input.MoveX (0, 0, axis 0), Input.MoveY (1, 0, axis 0), Input.JumpPressed (9, 1), Input.JumpReleased (9, 0). Each entry is (action, enabled[, axis]); button actions mode 2, axis actions mode 1.
